::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 17th [1897]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library  Add MSS 54921: 231
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_942.qmd)
I think it might be well to republish [Kenneth](cmy_books/cmybook_10.qmd). I would add a preface of apology for blunders

Yours truly
C M Yonge
